tagline: One tutor. One student. A plan built around you.
intro: Classmate offers fully one-on-one tutoring. Every student gets their own plan, assignments and exams, with Computer Science for Class 11 and 12 as our speciality.

tutors.name: Mohammed Rabiyath
tutors.qualification: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
tutors.experience: 2 years of teaching experience in Computer Science and Mathematics
tutors.bio: A passionate tutor and curious software developer, Rabiyath has been teaching Computer Science and Mathematics for the past 2 years. He believes in a personalized approach to learning, ensuring that each student grasps concepts thoroughly and applies them effectively.
tutors.subjects: Computer Science, Mathematics, Python Programming, Data Structures, SQL, Databases and Networks
